preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
Each string S must have a length between 1 and 100,000.
The total length of all strings S across test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(F(P) for P in distinct_substrings(S)) % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: The output must be the summation of F(P) for all distinct substrings P of S, modulo 10^9 + 7.
